response.overview: A film trailer directed by Jean-Luc Godard for his own classic picture "Le Mépris" (1963). The voice of a man and a woman tells us about the movie stars who are part of the cast (Brigitte Bardot, Jack Palance, Giorgia Moll, Michel Piccoli, and veteran director Fritz Lang) and also few significant elements about what the movie is destined to present to future audiences. Along with those, comes several intercut and colorful images from the classic film.
response.title: Bande-annonce de 'Le mépris'
